content.rendered:
It’s hard to find a more perfectly suited pairing for Bruce than the very-Springsteen-influenced Gaslight Anthem. It’s hard to tell who’s having more fun in this 2009 HD clip–Brian and Bruce are clearly both having a ball.

“The ’59 Sound” was the title track and lead single from The Gaslight Anthem’s second album. Released in the summer of 2008, it became a critical hit if not a popular one. (It peaked at #35 on the Billboard Alternative chart.)

The ’59 Sound
First performed: June 27, 2009 (Pilton, England)
Last performed: June 28, 2009 (London, England)

© January 27, 2018

jetpack-related-posts.title: December 9
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: On this date: Bruce surprises with a call-in to E Street Radio and a guest appearance with Gaslight Anthem, plus an emotional show the day after John Lennon's death. Much more inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: History Books
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: "It was going to seek the guy on the hill for wisdom, but really, it was Federici’s Pizza in Freehold. But some mythical work was done at that table. We brought the band back together.'"  --Brian Fallon, Associated Press News, July 20, 2023 Bruce Springsteen knows a thing or two…

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Chris Martin: My Love Will Not Let You Down
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: At the 23rd Bridge School Benefit, Chris Martin bravely attempts an acoustic cover of one of Bruce's hardest-rocking anthems.

jetpack-related-posts.title: London Calling
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce led an all-star line-up at the 2003 Grammy Awards to pay tribute to the late, great Joe Strummer.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll Over Beethoven
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce covered it several times over the years, as far back as 1971--but it took until 2009 before a taper could capture Bruce covering Chuck Berry's seminal classic, "Roll Over Beethoven."

jetpack-related-posts.title: All Shook Up
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: It takes a special performer to steal the show from Bruce Springsteen. Watch The Philly Elvis do it when Bruce grants his request on the Working on a Dream Tour.
